definitions.gloss: detour, side trip, stopping by on the way
definitions.explanation: Making a stop at a place that is not one's main destination while on the way somewhere. Can also be used figuratively for getting sidetracked from a main task or topic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{帰|かえ}り→帰り：01275_kaeri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{寄|よ}り{道|みち}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I made a stop on the way home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{帰|かえ}り→帰り：01275_kaeri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{寄|よ}り{道|みち}⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{帰|かえ}り→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: Come straight home from school without making any detours.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{帰|かえ}り→帰り：01275_kaeri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{寄|よ}り{道|みち}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{観光|かんこう}→観光：00173_kankou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: On the way back from a business trip, I made a side trip to Kyoto and enjoyed some sightseeing.

notes:
USAGE:
A warm, everyday word. Parents commonly tell children {寄|よ}り{道|みち}⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧ (don't make detours / come straight home). Also used figuratively: ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{寄|よ}り{道|みち}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (the conversation goes off on a tangent). The word conveys a casual, unhurried feeling — the detour is usually for pleasure or curiosity rather than necessity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寄|よ}り{道|みち}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make a detour, to stop by
- {寄|よ}り{道|みち}⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧: without making detours
- ⟦{帰|かえ}り→帰り：01275_kaeri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{寄|よ}り{道|みち}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to stop somewhere on the way home
- ⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧{寄|よ}り{道|みち}: a little side trip
